name: io.github.limitcool/quota-mcp
title: quota-mcp
description: Usage & quota tracker for AI subscription accounts (StepFun, Command Code)

environmentVariables.name: QUOTA_MCP_MASTER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: 64 hex chars AES master key for credential encryption (required in production; without it the key is derived from machine traits)

environmentVariables.name: QUOTA_MCP_DB
environmentVariables.description: SQLite path inside the container (default /data/quota-mcp.db, backed by the /data volume)
